_about: Each past national federal voting-intention poll's printed undecided share (percent of all respondents) and what it measures: "first" = can't say with no leaner question asked, set aside from the party shares; "leaner" = still undecided after a leaner question (set aside, or kept in the base where the house does so); "none" = no undecided option. Fieldwork ending 2004-10-10 to 2025-05-02 (the sitting term is data/polls.json). era separates a house's method eras. Assembled 2026-11-23 from Simon Jackman's public poll files, the ABC's 2022 file, Wikipedia's tables, The Poll Bludger, the houses' own releases and the site's house files (src per row). Fitted by .build/build-undecided-history.mjs into data/undecided-history-model.json.
